image_prompt.text: Caves, hollows, and nests through the jungle that animal and dinosaur players claim and return to
A structure visible across the prehistoric map so players can navigate by sight
An oversized clearing where players gather in numbers
A Jurassic-Park-style wilderness of jungle, open ground, and prehistoric terrain for animals and dinosaurs to live in

notes: Preset Animal Sim contributed all three options; the prompt asked only for a 3D map with animals and dinosaurs on it.
Marvel-style powers, stat upgrades, and an owner-only admin panel are not layout concerns and have no home in this handoff.

open_questions.ask: What do players actually do out there - hunt each other, roleplay, or grind stats?

answers.ask: What do players actually do out there - hunt each other, roleplay, or grind stats?
answers.answer: Players hunt and fight each other as animals and dinosaurs, earning progress to grind their stats and powers.

answers.ask: Should the stat upgrades happen at a place on the map, or through a menu?
answers.answer: Use a simple upgrade menu so players can spend their earned progress anywhere.
